title: peer-network human_gate

mission_id.description: F6 (Codex HOLD): a real mission ID, never blank/whitespace/free text — patterned like claim + event mission_id. A gate is the record of a human decision ON a mission; a blank mission is not one.

decided_by.description: The human who decided. Nonblank — whitespace (what a paste produces) is rejected.

decision_ref.description: Provenance: the immutable GitHub comment / review URL or id that records the decision.

description: A human decision on a merge / production deploy / architecture / secret / protected-infrastructure / physical-test gate. A gate in state approved or denied MUST name decided_by and decided_at — an approval with no human and no time is not a decision (law 12).
